description: deletion-correcting code constructions. an llm-guided funsearch adaptation recovered a function constructing the conjectured-optimal varshamov--tenengolts code for one deletion and improved prior finite constructions for multiple deletions and quaternary edit channels. proved construction and improved finite codes . the single-deletion construction is proved; the multi-deletion results are explicit computational constructions rather than a general theorem. \\

alphaevolve mathematics portfolio. the first public announcement reported new solutions or improved constructions across more than 50 open mathematical problems, including a 48-scalar-multiplication algorithm for complex matrices; later technical reports expanded the portfolio. improved algorithms and bounds . counted once at first public report; later papers are supporting documentation, not additional monthly entries. \\

-evolve cap-set and shannon-capacity constructions. a larger partial admissible set raised the cap-set constant lower bound to , while an independent set of size 19,946 in raised the corresponding shannon-capacity lower bound. improved lower bounds . explicit finite constructions in a technical preprint; grouped as one system-paper result package. \\

three-player approximate nash equilibrium. legone discovered a polynomial-time algorithm improving the worst-case guarantee from to , beyond the previously known multiplayer extension technique. improved algorithm and guarantee . the symbolic certificate establishes the worst-case guarantee. \\

optimality of black-box amplification in qma. doubly exponential completeness amplification is optimal for polynomial-resource black-box procedures. gpt-5 supplied a resolvent-trace idea used as a key technical step. proved lower bound . conventional expert-authored preprint; a coauthor publicly documented the model's role. \\

quantitative malliavin--stein fourth-moment bounds. gpt-5 extended qualitative fourth-moment results to explicit convergence rates in gaussian and poisson settings, addressing a question the authors report had not previously been treated. proved quantitative bounds . expert-authored paper; no proof-assistant formalization. \\

circle packing by sample-efficient program evolution. shinkaevolve reported a new best-known circle-packing construction using only 150 candidate samples. improved construction . computationally evaluated construction in an open-source system paper. \\

g"odel test, problem 2. gpt-5 derived a different approximation guarantee that refuted the authors' proposed conjecture while giving a valid replacement result. counterexample and theorem . the authors checked the derivation and document both successes and failures. \\

certification on random regular graphs. near-optimal upper and conditional lower bounds were obtained for certifying max-cut and max-independent set on random 3- and 4-regular graphs, using nearly extremal ramanujan graphs found by alphaevolve. sharper bounds . expert-authored proof with explicit ai-generated constructions and verification procedures. \\

max- -cut inapproximability. new gadget reductions improve np-hardness-of-approximation factors for max-4-cut and the best gadget-based factor for max-3-cut reported by the paper. improved hardness results . the reductions and soundness arguments are checked by the authors. \\

majority optimality in nicd with erasures. a five-bit unbiased boolean function beats five-bit majority at erasure probability , disproving the proposed optimality of majority. counterexample . the note verifies the finite computation step by step by hand. \\

point convergence of nesterov acceleration. the standard accelerated gradient method has point convergence in the paper's convex smooth setting, resolving a question open since the method's introduction. proved . expert-authored preprint with a documented elicitation process. \\

erdos problem 848. for sufficiently large , the extremal family of integers whose pairwise sums are never squarefree has the asserted maximum size, with near-uniqueness of the extremizers. proved . complete expert-written proof. \\

follow-the-leader for nested convex-body chasing. the minimum-norm rule can incur arbitrarily large cost even in two dimensions, so its competitive ratio is infinite. counterexample . human expert corrected minor inaccuracies and presented the proof. \\

convex-body chasing lower bounds. a cleaner and stronger lower-bound construction for arbitrary online algorithms was obtained, with a higher-dimensional extension by orthogonal decomposition. improved bound . expert-written proof documenting useful and failed attempts. \\

second tree-profile inequality. the remaining open inequality among the first two conjectured faces for induced five-vertex subtree counts is true. proved . ai-generated proof with expert checking and editorial rewriting. \\

identifiability in a dynamic random network. in an attractiveness-weighted preferential-attachment tree, the hidden parameter is identifiable from one large unlabelled tree through the limiting fraction of leaves. proved . humans filled routine stochastic-approximation details. \\

thetaevolve open-problem portfolio. a single open-source 8b model improved reported bounds on circle packing and the first autocorrelation inequality. two improved bounds . aggregate portfolio entry supported by released code and a technical report. \\

grover-compatible manifold optimization. a human--ai workflow identified invariant subspaces, constructed compatible retractions, and established convergence guarantees for a retraction-based gradient method. theory and convergence results . human authors refined outputs into precise statements and rigorous proofs. \\

extremal descendant integrals. for pure -class intersection numbers on , the minimum occurs when all but one exponent vanish, while balanced exponent vectors maximize the value. proved , with partial . the paper exposes prompts, attribution, and a partial lean development. \\

fel's syzygy conjecture. the normalized alternating syzygy power sums of a numerical semigroup satisfy fel's explicit formula in terms of gap power sums and universal symmetric polynomials. proved +. fully formalized in lean/mathlib and presented in a mathematical paper. \\

parity of -differentials in genus zero and one. the number-theoretic hypothesis underlying the previously conditional spin-parity classification is true, making the geometric result unconditional. proved with on the key combinatorial identity. the paper does not claim full end-to-end formalization of every geometric step. \\

dead ends in square-free digit walks. for every base , the asymptotic dead-end density exists and has a finite alternating euler-product formula; in base ten it is about . proved +. fully formalized in lean/mathlib. \\

partial regularity of primes. for every , a density-one subset of primes is partially regular through the range , with a partial vandiver consequence. proved +. main theorem fully formalized in lean/mathlib. \\

small prime factors of binomial coefficients. the relevant threshold for small prime divisors of has a polylogarithmic upper bound and is logarithmically large for infinitely many . bounds proved . human authors state the proofs were entirely model-generated; they digested and edited the exposition. \\

partition-resistant additive basis. there exists an additive basis of order two such that for every partition , at least one of or has unbounded gaps. counterexample / construction . model-generated proof, checked and rewritten by expert authors. \\

prime multiples are not well distributed. for every real , the sequence of fractional parts , with prime, is not well distributed in the hlawka--petersen sense. proved . model-generated proof, checked and rewritten by expert authors. \\

vlasov--maxwell--landau equilibrium. under the stated smoothness and decay assumptions, a steady state on the torus is a spatially uniform maxwellian, with vanishing electric field and constant magnetic field. proved +. full lean 4 development; one mathematician supervised and audited definitions. \\

cosmic-string radiation integral. exact analytical evaluations of the core integral for arbitrary loop geometries, together with large- asymptotics, yield the gravitational-radiation power spectrum. open problem resolved . analytical paper with numerical cross-checks; not a proof-assistant formalization. \\

ordinary lines without an ordinary clique. for the nontrivial cases of erdos problem 960, there are planar sets with no four collinear, a bipartite ordinary-line graph, and quadratically many ordinary lines, refuting the conjectured sparse behavior. disproved . human-verified and digested; all nontrivial cases addressed in the paper. \\

uniformly small exponential sums. a randomized dyadic construction gives a real sequence with near-optimal uniform control of its exponential sums, close to clunie's lower bound. construction . model-generated, expert-checked preprint. \\

-free critical graphs with few chords. there are arbitrarily large -free, -critical graphs in which every cycle has at most ten chords, disproving erdos problem 1091. counterexample . model found the family; human authors made a minor proof-level simplification. \\

fewnomial erdos--tur\'an analogue. replacing polynomial degree by support size in a proposed root-discrepancy bound fails: a sparse bounded-height family has a positive real root of growing multiplicity. counterexample . model-generated, expert-checked preprint. \\
primes of the form . for each fixed positive integer , only finitely many have prime for every coprime to . proved . model-generated proof; generalizes erdos problem 1141. \\

anderson's quasi-completeness problem. a weakly quasi-complete noetherian local ring need not be quasi-complete. counterexample +. end-to-end lean 4 proof with essentially no human involvement in solving/formalizing; separately presented in a human-verified paper. \\

planar unit-distance conjecture. there are infinitely many for which an -point planar set determines at least unit-distance pairs for some fixed , disproving the conjectured upper-order behavior. disproved +. external mathematicians checked the proof and produced a digested companion paper. preprint, but unusually strong public expert validation. \\

boij--s"oderberg realization over graded lie algebras. the analogous realization assertion for arbitrary finite-dimensional positively graded lie algebras generated in degree one is false. disproved . explicit negative construction, human verified. \\

optimal bend-and-break for foliations. for every rank- foliation on a normal projective variety, the optimal constant in the tangent rational-curve bend-and-break inequality is . proved . authors describe the proof as ai-generated and human verified. \\

semifree differential graded algebras. stable tame isomorphism, quasi-isomorphism, and derived morita equivalence are all undecidable for semifree noncommutative dgas. proved undecidable . expert-authored mathematical paper; resolves half of a published low-dimensional-topology problem. \\

erdos problem 12(i). an infinite set satisfying the problem's divisibility restriction and its prescribed density condition infinitely often exists. proved +. lean proof; experts checked statement fidelity. \\

erdos problem 12(ii). the stronger companion assertion, imposing the density condition for every parameter and all sufficiently large scales, also holds. proved +. lean proof; experts checked statement fidelity. \\

erdos problem 125. if and are the nonnegative integers using only digits in bases three and four, then has lower density zero. proved +. the system first helped expose a density misformalization; the corrected statement was then proved. \\

erdos problem 138, variant. a formalized variant giving a bound for van der waerden numbers is proved by greedy coloring extension and a monochromatic-intersection lemma. proved +. formal variant, clearly marked as such in the source. \\
erdos problem 152. every sufficiently large sidon set has many isolated points in its sumset . proved +. lean proof; experts checked the formalization. \\

erdos problem 741(i). a positive-upper-density set admits the decomposition required by the problem, with both pieces retaining positive upper density. proved +. corrected upper-density reading; lean proof. \\
erdos problem 741(ii). there exists an additive basis of order two satisfying the problem's simultaneous bounded-gap requirements. proved +. lean proof. \\

erdos problem 846. there is an infinite planar set not expressible as a finite union of general-position sets, although every finite subset contains many non-collinear points. proved +. lean proof and expert statement review. \\

erdos problem 26, generalized variant. a set with prescribed upper-density behavior under all natural dilations exists. proved +. the source explicitly notes that this is a more general variant rather than erdos's original wording. \\

oeis conjectures. the agent proved 44 of 492 autoformalized open conjectures after test-lemma and manual statement checks. published exemplars concern the asymptotic number of subsets of with integral average and integrality of coefficients from hankel determinants. 44 proved +. aggregate result; the paper reports manual review for correct formalization and prior-unproved status. \\

anchored gradient descent--ascent. an exact last-iterate convergence rate is proved for anchored gda in convex--concave min--max optimization, using a newly discovered parameter schedule. proved / improved bound +. formal proof; later work extended the result. \\

weak bipartite graph reconstruction. a proposed reconstruction algorithm is correct for the paper's bipartite setting under an additional vertex-type condition; the unrestricted bipartite statement remains open. conditional theorem +. formal proof of the restricted theorem, not of the full reconstruction conjecture. \\

graffiti leaf-bound conjecture. a 1996 graph-theory conjecture relating the maximum number of leaves in a spanning tree to independent sets in vertex neighborhoods is proved. proved +. formal proof; exact statement supplied in the cited source/repository. \\
zanello's conjecture. every pure -sequence of codimension three and type two is log-concave. proved +. formal proof with substantial reformulation and case analysis. \\

green's problem 57. the intended complex-valued equality of two quadratically structured function spaces is false; a candidate finite cyclic counterexample was formally certified. disproved +. counterexample is formally checked, but the dedicated paper was still in preparation at the source date. \\

finite conductor and group rings. the finite-conductor property does not necessarily ascend from a g--gcd ring to for finitely generated abelian . counterexample . self-contained ai-generated proof, subsequently verified by human experts. \\
quasi-coherence and group rings. the quasi-coherent property likewise need not ascend from a g--gcd ring to its group ring. counterexample . ai-generated, human-verified preprint. \\
integer-valued polynomial birings. there exists an integral domain for which admits no compatible -- biring structure of the specified kind. counterexample . ai-generated, human-verified preprint. \\
agcd domains. if every nonzero -locally principal ideal of an almost-gcd domain is -invertible, then the domain has finite -character. proved . ai-generated, human-verified preprint. \\
david's domain. david's three-dimensional non-noetherian factorial domain is locally jaffard. proved . ai-generated, human-verified preprint. \\

boij--s"oderberg realization, codimension three. not every integral point on a codimension-three pure ray is realized over or the enveloping algebra of the heisenberg lie algebra. disproved . explicit negative construction, human verified. \\
book ramsey number. . proved +. lean formalization of the upper bound accompanies the paper; lower bound was known. \\

cycle double cover conjecture. every finite bridgeless graph has a multiset of cycles covering every edge exactly twice. claimed proof +. a specialist clarification exists, but the claim was only days old at the cut-off and had not completed conventional peer review. \\

ap\'ery's constant and chemical reaction networks. is crn-computable via a machine-checked construction from its holonomic generating function. proved +. no admitted gaps; very recent july preprint. \\

jacobian conjecture. a recently announced polynomial map with constant nonzero jacobian determinant and multiple preimages would disprove keller's conjecture in dimension three, and hence in all dimensions , if the announced construction withstands further checking. claimed counterexample +. public announcement and rapid symbolic verification have circulated, but the result was only just announced at the report cut-off and should not yet be treated as a fully settled theorem. \\
